item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera looks at the night sky from her terrace in Jaipur. She notices that the Sun looks large and bright during the day, but all other stars look like tiny points of light and cannot be seen in the daytime. What is the best explanation for this?

options.A: The Sun is the nearest star to the Earth, so it appears large and bright; other stars are extremely far away, so they appear as tiny points, and their light is hidden by the bright daytime sky.
options.B: The Sun is the biggest star in the universe, so it looks larger and brighter than every other star.
options.C: Other stars stop shining during the daytime, which is why only the Sun can be seen.
options.D: Other stars are closer to the Earth than the Sun, so they look smaller.
